question: This revolutionary freedom fighter co-founded the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association in 1928. Along with B K Dutt, he threw a bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly in 1929. He was tried and executed at the age of 23, along with revolutionaries Sukhdev Thapar and Shivaram Rajguru. The freedom fighter is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagat Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagat Singh** was a revolutionary freedom fighter who played a significant role in India's struggle for independence.
 
• He co-founded the **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA)** in **1928**, which aimed to achieve independence through revolutionary means. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• In **1929**, Bhagat Singh and B K Dutt threw a bomb in the **Central Legislative Assembly** in Delhi to protest against oppressive laws. This act was symbolic and intended to make the British government hear the voice of Indians. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• **Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev Thapar, and Shivaram Rajguru** were tried and executed in **1931** for their involvement in revolutionary activities against British rule. Bhagat Singh was only **23 years old** at the time of his execution. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• Bhagat Singh's sacrifice and revolutionary ideas inspired generations of Indians to fight for freedom. He remains one of India's most celebrated heroes. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Bhagat Singh.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA):**

 
 
• The **HSRA** was formed in **1928** by Bhagat Singh, Chandra Shekhar Azad, and other revolutionaries.
 
• Its aim was to overthrow British rule and establish a socialist republic in India.
 
• The association believed in using revolutionary methods to fight British colonialism.
 
 
 
• **Incident at Central Legislative Assembly:**
 
 
• On **April 8, 1929**, Bhagat Singh and B K Dutt threw bombs in the assembly to protest against the **Trade Disputes Bill** and Public Safety Bill.
 
• The bombs were not intended to kill but to create noise and draw attention to the cause of Indian independence.
